messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the falcon-7b-q4 rollout to dedicated pool us-west-2, we’re seeing two things: sporadic factual hallucinations on date-sensitive prompts and ~2x latency for mult-turn chat (>1024 tokens). :eyes:

tom: Ack. Any examples/logs?

maria: Example from prod user convo: asked 'When did the beta launch?' model replied 'Feb 2026' (should be Oct 2024). Dumped the response in #support-ticket-4132. Stack trace shows tokenization + weird role prompting but that looked normal.

jake: Also seeing TPS drop on the worker that serves the q4 variant: last 10m tokens/sec went from 2700 -> 1400. CPU on host low, GPU SM utilization spiky.

eva: Repro locally with the same prompt set? Can we run the eval harness (unit prompt set) against q4 vs fp16 baseline? I can run the suite.

maria: I kicked off quick eval: falcon-7b-fp16 vs falcon-7b-q4 vs falcon-7b-q4+kvcache on a small prompt corpus. Initial results: QA exact-match down 4.8% on q4, q4+kvcache recovers ~2%. Latency (p50) for long sequences: fp16 120ms/token, q4 250ms/token.

sasha: Interesting — did the quantized kernel accidentally disable fused attention kernels? I saw a config change in the runtime: kernel_selector=auto -> kernel_selector=legacy in the last deploy. deploy-bot: "deploy 2025-08-19T03:12:22 by jake".

tom: If kernel_selector switched, that explains latency. Can we revert kernel selector and see? Maria, can you pin a canary route to the fp16 build for affected customers?

maria: Routed affected orgs back to falcon-7b-fp16 canary (route id r-8b2). Rolling back global model not yet, want to validate root cause.

jake: Quick mitigation: increase kv-cache TTL to 30s and enable prefix caching for chat sessions — reduced p99 by ~15% in my local run. But hallucinations persist.

eva: For the hallucinations, could be quantization-induced numeric drift on positional embeddings or a preprocessing tokenization mismatch. Can we re-run logits-diff for tokens around date entities? I’ll run a diff between fp16 and q4 for the failing case.

maria: Doing logits diffs now. Also noticed the server loaded config with context_len=2048 but the model was compiled for 4096; maybe truncation caused shifted positions. That could affect date tokens.

tom: Ok that’s high priority. Action items: 1) Re-run eval harness with context_len aligned (maria), 2) Revert kernel_selector to fused path for q4 experiments (tom), 3) Jake to iterate on kv-cache settings and monitor TPS, 4) Eva to produce logits-diff and token-level mismatch report. Post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: "rollback suggestion: if SLA impacted, call rollback endpoint: POST /admin/rollback {model: 'falcon-7b-q4', target: 'fp16'}"

maria: Filing a post-launch issue in tracker: ML-1079 with initial notes and reference prompts. I’ll attach baseline eval CSV and a small repro.

sasha: If we confirm context_len mismatch was the culprit, add a preflight check to onboarding: compiled_context == runtime_context. Also add a quantization smoke test: small eval on date-sensitive items + perf profile.

jake: Agreed. I’ll draft onboarding checklist PR for eng-ml that includes: config verification, kernel selector sanity, kv-cache sanity, and a minimal QA prompt set for critical entity types.

maria: Thank you everyone. I’ll update ML-1079 with timestamps and whether rollback is needed after eva's diffs. :thumbsup:

eva: Posted logits-diff gist: https://internal.gists/repro/ld-1753024000 — preliminary finding: q4 shifts token logits around dates by ~0.6 logits on avg, and combined with truncation it flips highest-prob token. Full report in ML-1079.

tom: Once Maria confirms context_len fix, we can re-run q4 with fused kernels and kv-cache, then re-evaluate. If perf still bad, hold q4 from Dedicated until we resolve.

maria: Update at 1753024600: context_len mismatch confirmed. Recompiling model for 2048 and re-running perf. If clean, will move route back to q4+fused in canary for two orgs. Closing interim.
